Franchement, super adresse à Phuket. L’équipe et le Propriétaire est vraiment sympa, accueillante et prend le temps de bien conseiller sans pousser à l’achat.

Le choix est sympa, les produits sont de bonne qualité et les prix sont vraiment corrects.
Gros plus pour l’accueil et la sélection c’est toujours agréable quand on est à Phuket

On se sent tout de suite à l’aise, pas du tout l’ambiance commerciale ou touristique qu’on peut parfois trouver ailleurs.

Je recommande sans hésiter, que ce soit pour les Français de passage ou ceux qui vivent à Phuket. Une équipe au top 👍🇹🇭
reviews.text_en:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Honestly, a fantastic place in Phuket. The team and the owner are really friendly and welcoming, and they take the time to give good advice without pressuring you to buy.

The selection is great, the products are good quality, and the prices are very reasonable. A big plus for the welcome and the selection; it's always a pleasure when you're in Phuket.

You immediately feel at ease; it's nothing like the commercial or touristy atmosphere you sometimes find elsewhere.

I highly recommend it, whether you're a French person just passing through or a resident of Phuket. A top-notch team! 👍🇹🇭

reviews.text: Nice place to light up, good selection of strains at excellent prices. Also helpful if you’re unsure which one to select
Best dispensary in Patong hands down! Super friendly staff, clean shop, chill vibe and top shelf quality. Fair prices for the area too. Highly recommended!
The best in patong 🔥

One of the best cannabis shops in Patong, Phuket. YSL has a really good selection of high quality flower, and you can tell they actually care about the quality rather than just having a huge amount of average products. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable and happy to help you choose the right strain.

The shop itself is clean, well presented and has a really cool atmosphere. Great location in Patong, close to the beach and Bangla Road, which makes it an easy place to stop by.

If you’re looking for quality cannabis in Phuket with good service and a relaxed atmosphere, I’d definitely recommend YSL. One of the best cannabis shops I’ve visited in Thailand and I’ll definitely be coming back.

Really good experience at Young Stoner Life (YSL) in Patong, Phuket. Friendly staff, great quality products, fair prices, and a chill atmosphere. The team was helpful and made it easy to find exactly what I wanted. Definitely one of the better cannabis shops in Patong highly recommend checking them out if you’re in Phuket.
Best weed in Phuket! Super friendly staff and top quality strains. A must visit Patong Phuket.
Top-tier cannabis with excellent terpene profiles and smooth smoke. The store is modern, clean, and the budtenders are very helpful.

I stopped by this shop recently and had an amazing experience. The quality of the weed here is honestly some of the best I’ve come across — super fresh, great flavor, and really well curated. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and helped me pick out the perfect strains for what I needed. The shop is clean, organized, and has a really comfortable vibe. If you’re looking for top-quality weed and great service, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommend!

I had an amazing experience at YSL Cannabis Store in Patong, Phuket! The shop offers a wide variety of top-quality cannabis products, from premium flower strains to soothing rap music. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, always ready to provide personalized recommendations. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the store is clean and well-organized. Plus, the location in Patong makes it super convenient for both locals and tourists. Highly recommend YSL Cannabis Store for anyone in Phuket looking for quality products and excellent service!
